role_id.description: Constraints: PK, AUTO_INCREMENT | Unique role identifier

role_name.description: Constraints: NOT NULL, UNIQUE | Customer / Kitchen Staff / Rider / Manager / Admin / Support

permissions.description: Array of permission keys granted to this role

is_active.description: Constraints: DEFAULT TRUE | Whether this role is currently in use

created_at.description: Constraints: DEFAULT NOW() | Record creation timestamp
